measured_biases: Python plus C++ account for 43/80 repositories (53.75%).
59/80 repositories (73.75%) have at least 2,000 stars; only 4/80 are below 500 stars.
52/80 repositories (65%) were pushed within 30 days of observation.
19/80 repositories (23.75%) report UNKNOWN or NOASSERTION license metadata.
Wave 5 therefore over-samples visible, established, active repositories and under-samples very new, low-star, dormant/archived, and less-common-language projects.
next_wave_requirements: Include explicit star strata with a large LT_500 cohort.
Include dormant/archived repositories as historical counterevidence, labeled as such.
Increase representation of languages outside Python/C++ and UNKNOWN-language curated lists.
Capture explicit license metadata before any code-level reuse; UNKNOWN/NOASSERTION is not permission.
Preserve activity/age strata so current implementation advice is not inferred from historical repositories.
